title: Al Williamson
description: The relentless stormtroopers, patrol dogs for the Empire, as emisioned by Al Williamson. It was back in 1949 that Williamson began his career with JOHN WAYNE COMICS for Toby Press - Al Capp's company. Memorable science-fiction stories for EC followed, along with Timely westerns. A longtime admirer of Alex Raymond's elegant, swashbuckling creations, Williamson rendered the FLASH GORDON newspaper strip ('66-'67) for King Features as well as the enduring SECRET AGENT X-9.
